ppr.v: PPR (parking authorisation for apron clearance) mandatory for all general and business aviation flights
ppr.quote: It is mandatory for all flights in the category of General/Business Aviation (GA/BA), IFR/VFR, State, Military

handling.v: all PPR requests go through a ground handler holding an HCAA category 1 licence
handling.quote: All PPR requests must be cleared through a Ground Handling Service Provider with a valid category 1 License by HCAA
